import pytest
import sqlglot

def test_databricks_insert_replace_using():
    sql = """
INSERT INTO TABLE students
    REPLACE USING (country)
    SELECT * FROM new_students;
"""
    with pytest.raises(sqlglot.errors.ParseError):
        sqlglot.parse_one(sql, dialect="databricks")
"}}
